summary: Build foundational NIS 2 Directive knowledge with PECB training, practical exercises, and exam preparation for the Foundation credential.
audienceIntro: This NIS 2 Directive Foundation course is designed for people who need a first structured introduction to the Directive’s cybersecurity concepts and requirements. It is relevant when your work involves cybersecurity measures, secure systems, critical-system resilience, or enforcing the Directive.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course.
